outcome: longitudinal striations in long bone metaphyses
cohort: Twelve patients, aged 5 months to 38 years, diagnosed with OSCS due to pathogenic AMER1 mutations.
finding: The study documents common facial dysmorphology and rare extraskeletal features of OSCS, such as intestinal malrotation and pyloric stenosis.
cross-section timing: Patients were observed at ages ranging from 5 months to 38 years.
